lib/presenters/report_format.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
module Presenters
  class ReportFormat
    FORMATS = { plain: ->(page) { "#{page.path}: #{page.visits_count}" }, csv: ->(page) { "#{page.path},#{page.visits_count}" } }.freeze
    def self.render(page, format: :plain)
      FORMATS.fetch(format).call(page)
    end
  end
end

spec/tests/reviewer_feature_spec.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/page'
require_relative '../../lib/presenters/report_format'
RSpec.describe Presenters::ReportFormat do
  it 'renders a plain report' do
    page = PathTracker::Page.new('/home')
    expect(described_class.render(page)).to eq('/home: 0')
    expect(described_class.render(page, format: :csv)).to eq('/home,0')
  end
end
